proposals.action_title: Launch First Niche Coloring Book on Amazon KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: The coloring book market is highly visual and searchable. Using a highly specific micro-niche (e.g., 'French Countryside Castles' using the produce_chateau_local pipeline) removes competition. Low pricing (4.99 EUR) helps trigger early sales and reviews.
proposals.first_action_today: Take the top 25 images from the produce_chateau_local pipeline, compile them into a 120-page PDF on Termux using python-pdfkit or an online tool, and design a high-contrast cover.

proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D has a very low barrier to entry and active organic traffic looking for functional prints. Uploading 5 customizable parametric models (using produce_stl_parametric) at a low price (1.99 EUR) converts 3D printing enthusiasts looking for utility.
proposals.first_action_today: Register the Cults3D account, render 3D preview images using a free online STL viewer on Android, and upload the first 2 parametric models with clear print settings in the description.

proposals.why_this_works_now: Text-only designs bypass the current image generation rate-limits entirely. Using Termux + Pillow to generate 30 funny, highly specific tech/programmer/French culture quotes onto transparent PNGs yields high-margin sticker sales with 0 API cost.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a quick Python script in Termux using PIL/Pillow to overlay 15 funny developer quotes on transparent 4000x4000px canvases and queue them for Redbubble upload.

proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers browse itch.io daily for prototyping assets. Uploading 3 simple asset packs (using produce_gamedev_asset_pack) as 'Name Your Own Price' with a suggested $1.99 price triggers impulse tips while maintaining high search visibility.
proposals.first_action_today: Zip the existing generated gamedev assets, write a short markdown description emphasizing royalty-free commercial license, and upload to itch.io.

proposals.why_this_works_now: The default Redbubble markup is 20%, which makes stickers yield pennies. Increasing the sticker markup to 60-70% only raises the retail price by a few cents but more than doubles the profit margin per unit sold.
proposals.first_action_today: Go to Redbubble Account Settings > Product Pricing, change the default markup for Stickers & Magnets to 65%, and apply it to all current and future listings.

proposals.action_title: Publish Low-Content Bible Verse Journals on KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: Religious and inspirational low-content books are evergreen. By combining the outputs of produce_bible_verses_v2 with produce_lowcontent_kdp, Hugo can rapidly publish 10 lined journals targeting long-tail keywords with minimal competition.
proposals.first_action_today: Use a pre-made 120-page lined interior PDF, generate 5 covers featuring distinct typography of uplifting bible verses, and list them on KDP at 5.99 EUR.
